info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Support Tickets Escalates-v1-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Escalation API provides a streamlined method for retrieving a list of support tickets that require escalation. This endpoint allows customer service teams to quickly identify and prioritize tickets based on predefined criteria, improving response times and enhancing customer satisfaction. Use cases include monitoring urgent issues, managing workload efficiently, and ensuring high-priority customer queries do not go unnoticed. Typical consumers include support agents and team leads who need to manage escalations effectively.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to escalate a support ticket to a higher level of support for expedited handling. This operation typically involves notifying senior support staff and may also involve changing the ticket's priority.

requestBody.description: Request body for escalating a ticket. This operation requires specific details about the ticket that is to be escalated, ensuring the appropriate action can be taken.

ListSupportTicketsEscalatesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for escalating a ticket operation in the system. It is expected to be a string containing relevant information regarding the escalate request.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the escalation request.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the escalation request.

resultId.description: An identifier linking to the result of the escalation process.

state.description: The current state of the ticket after escalation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the escalation, measured in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing more details about the escalation result.

audit.description: Audit information related to the escalation action.

ListSupportTicketsEscalatesResponse_200.description: Response schema for the successful escalation of tickets in the Operations system.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the escalation was performed automatically by the system.

Audit.description: Information about the audit of the escalation process.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the total time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
